comparison: Six API search regressions; original full comparison in guard-results.json; no additional targets or controls.
success: At least one API composition passes all frozen examples/checks while slices over the same package do not.
novelty: Known-solution/assisted controls only. No autonomous open-world novelty or advantageous target integration is claimed.
selection: Operator chose packaging from the PR120 demand naming it, and pathspec from a related issue already naming a working solution. Neither is a blind source choice.
negative_controls: Both cross-domain package/contract pairings and the historical raw-HTTP contract. Unknown runtime remains unknown.
export_rule: First behavioral_witness in stable candidate order per positive contract; replay same frozen cases, not new validation.
ablation: Compare direct API functions with compositions within the same enumerated catalog. Existing evaluator also applies its first-input identity ablation.
simple_alternative: One stdlib baseline: any(fnmatchcase(path, pattern) for pattern in patterns), frozen before execution. A plausible incomplete shortcut, not the best known solution.
timing: Runner duration and host prepare/assess durations kept separate; do not compare end-to-end PR120 cost with these offline-only runs.
changes: Conservatively omit decorated classes and their descendants. Require factory class receiver and method instance receiver to match the composition. Re-run six API searches; six slice plans are byte-identical and their observations are reused from guard-results.json.
timing_note: Observed latency, not a controlled performance benchmark. Local full suite is no longer running.
